target.title: fix(router): describe re-review comment upsert
target.body:
## Summary

- make the `@clawsweeper re-review` acknowledgement describe the durable review comment's real create-or-update behavior
- cover both the missing-comment creation path and the existing-comment update path with regression assertions

Fixes #581.

## What to review

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/repair/comment-router-core.ts` | Replace the assumption that a durable review comment already exists with mutually exclusive create-if-needed or update-in-place wording. |
| `test/repair/comment-router-core.test.ts` | Assert both alternatives and reject the former existing-comment and sequential-lifecycle assumptions. |

Diffstat: 2 files changed, 7 insertions, 3 deletions.

## How it works

The command acknowledgement now mirrors the publication contract: when the queued review finishes, ClawSweeper creates the durable review comment if none exists or updates the existing durable comment in place.

This does not change dispatch or publication behavior; it corrects the immediate status text shown after a valid re-review request.

## Real behavior proof

Using the same `re_review` command input against the renderer on `origin/main` and this branch:

Before (`origin/main` at `6248fba9f8cdbea81b9ffb8aefb15a95cf0d3d3a`):

```text
Result: the existing ClawSweeper review comment will be edited in place when the review finishes.
```

After (`d4ef85a3773808b9fda4a122d44fddb6582da802`):

```text
Result: when the review finishes, ClawSweeper will create the durable review comment if needed or update the existing comment in place.
```

The proof manifest binds both captures to the exact base and head SHAs.

## Testing

- `pnpm run build:all && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check:active-surface && pnpm run check:limits`
- focused renderer regression under Node 24.18.0
- kanarienkrebs TS runtime validation: layer active, test exercised, no diagnostics
- marmorkrebs/Stryker on changed line 2166: 1 mutant killed, 0 survived (100%)
- complete unit, repair, changed-coverage, and full-coverage commands were executed locally before the final rebase; the changed renderer test and coverage thresholds pass. The macOS run also hit unrelated deadline/network-sensitive assertions, including failures reproduced on the then-current untouched `origin/main`; the GitHub Linux matrix remains the authoritative clean-CI check on the final head.

## Not included

- review queue scheduling or latency changes
- durable review comment publication logic
- changes to the existing in-place update behavior once a durable comment exists

## Risk and mitigation

Risk is limited to public acknowledgement copy. The regression test pins the mutually exclusive create-or-update wording, while the before/after renderer capture verifies the actual emitted text.
